% !TeX root = slides.tex
% ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
% UPF beamer slides — blank deck.
% Fill in the three metadata fields (title, author, institute), then add
% \begin{frame}...\end{frame} blocks for your content. Do NOT change the
% theme/color/footline block above the metadata unless you mean to: it
% encodes the three house requirements (UPF red, name+affiliation at the
% bottom, default font).
% ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
\documentclass[aspectratio=169,12pt]{beamer}

% ── UPF house theme (do not edit) ────────────────────────────────────
\definecolor{upfred}{HTML}{C8102E}     % UPF institutional red

\usetheme{Madrid}
\usecolortheme[named=upfred]{structure}

% No font package is loaded on purpose: beamer's default (Computer Modern
% sans) is "the standard font". Do not add fontspec/helvet/times/etc.

\setbeamertemplate{navigation symbols}{}

% Footline: name + affiliation always bottom-left, frame number bottom-right.
\setbeamertemplate{footline}{%
  \leavevmode%
  \hbox{%
    \begin{beamercolorbox}[wd=.78\paperwidth,ht=2.5ex,dp=1ex,left]{author in head/foot}%
      \hspace*{2ex}\usebeamerfont{author in head/foot}%
      \insertshortauthor\;\textbar\;\insertshortinstitute
    \end{beamercolorbox}%
    \begin{beamercolorbox}[wd=.22\paperwidth,ht=2.5ex,dp=1ex,right]{title in head/foot}%
      \usebeamerfont{title in head/foot}%
      \insertframenumber{}/\inserttotalframenumber\hspace*{2ex}
    \end{beamercolorbox}%
  }%
  \vskip0pt%
}

\setbeamerfont{title}{size=\Large,series=\bfseries}
\setbeamerfont{frametitle}{size=\large,series=\bfseries}
\setbeamercolor{frametitle}{fg=upfred,bg=white}
\setbeamercolor{block title}{bg=upfred,fg=white}
\setbeamercolor{block body}{bg=upfred!5,fg=black}
\setbeamercolor{itemize item}{fg=upfred}
\setbeamercolor{itemize subitem}{fg=upfred!70}
\setbeamertemplate{itemize item}{\raise1pt\hbox{\small$\bullet$}}
\setbeamertemplate{itemize subitem}{\raise1pt\hbox{\scriptsize$\bullet$}}

% ── Packages ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
\usepackage{graphicx}
\usepackage{booktabs}
\usepackage{amsmath}
\usepackage{adjustbox}

% ── Metadata (FILL THESE IN) ─────────────────────────────────────────
% \author[<short>]{<full>}: the short form is what shows in the footline.
% \institute[<short>]{<full>}: the short form is the affiliation in the footline.
\title[Short Title]{Full Presentation Title}
\author[Brady Allardice]{Brady Allardice}
\institute[Universitat Pompeu Fabra]{Universitat Pompeu Fabra}
\date{\today}

% ═════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
\begin{document}

% ── Title slide (footline suppressed; affiliation shown under name) ───
{
\setbeamertemplate{footline}{}
\begin{frame}[plain]
\vspace{1.2cm}
\begin{center}
  {\Large\bfseries\color{upfred} \inserttitle}\\[10pt]
  {\normalsize \insertauthor}\\[4pt]
  {\small\color{gray} \insertinstitute}\\[16pt]
  % Optional logos — uncomment and point at your image files:
  % \includegraphics[height=1.4cm]{upflogo.png}\\[14pt]
  {\small\color{gray} \insertdate}
\end{center}
\end{frame}
}

% ── Content slides ───────────────────────────────────────────────────
% Add your frames here, e.g.:
%
% \begin{frame}{Frame Title}
%   Content goes here.
% \end{frame}

\end{document}
